**Ascending Duel is now Duello.** The game is no longer a climb up a tower: a run is a journey from
realm to realm, and every realm is chosen through a portal.

- **New name and title screen.** The window, the title screen and the credits say Duello, and the
  alternate title image is gone.
- **Realms, not floors.** Every screen, achievement and message that said floor now says realm, and
  the FIFTH FLOOR achievement is FIFTH REALM.
- **Choose your realm.** After each realm's portal room, two portals open onto two realms — a
  kind of creature in an element — and you walk through one. A realm offered once is never
  offered again in the same run.
- **Your saves start fresh.** Profiles and runs now live in `%APPDATA%\duello` on Windows and
  `~/.config/duello` on Linux. Nothing is carried over from the old folder, and every run code now
  deals a different journey.
- **Downloads are renamed** to `duello-<version>-windows-amd64.exe` and
  `duello-<version>-linux-amd64.tar.gz`.
